        ### Question

        ### Options

CHAIN: "Each muscle fiber is innervated by a single motor neuron" -> "This ensures precise control of muscle contraction" -> "Therefore, option opc is correct" -> 90%
CHAIN: "Muscle fibers require stimulation to contract" -> "Summation of synaptic potentials can lead to action potentials" -> "This is necessary to reach the excitation threshold" -> "Thus, option opd is correct" -> 85%
